240-5470-7060-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

116-2645-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

687-4613-5231-8130-8131.description:
Cast Aven Eternal by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Aven Eternal enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Aven Eternal and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Aven Eternal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4613-5231-8130-8131.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

967-3809-3899-4365-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2292-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1879-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

997-1580-4871-6248.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-539-1355-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six enchantments.
215-539-1355-7781.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Sanctum Weaver
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-2469-5220-6559.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2469-5220-6900-7286.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

5778-6753-7179.description:
Cast Exalted Sunborn for its warp cost by paying {1}{W} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Exalted Sunborn enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating two token copies of it that are 1/1.
Cast Disruptor of Currents by paying at most {U}{U} and tapping the three Exalted Sunborns, plus an additional {2} at most for its offspring cost.
When Disruptor of Currents enters, its innate ability and offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating eight token copies of it that are 1/1 due to the Exalted Sunborns.
When the Disruptor of Currents tokens enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning the nontoken Disruptor of Currents from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Cast Disruptor of Currents by tapping five Disruptor of Currents tokens and tapping an additional two Disruptor of Currents tokens to pay its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 4.
5778-6753-7179.notes: The mana needed can be reduce if you can convoke more creatures while casting Disruptor of Currents the first time.

224-6657-7119.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You have a card in hand.
224-6657-7119.description:
Activate Dreamscape Artist by paying {2}{U}, tapping it, discarding a card and sacrificing a land.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dreamscape Artist's ability.
Resolve the copy of Dreamscape Artist's ability, causing you to search your library for two basic lands and put them onto the battlefield.
When the basic lands enter, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers twice, untapping Gogo and another creature.
Holding priority, activate the basic lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

5147-5170-6132-6772.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4506-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4506-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

338-5086-5183-5231-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-5086-5183-5231-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

2350-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2816-3771-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2816-3771-7070.notes: The starting cost can be reduced depending on the number of +1/+1 counters on Animar.

2942-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Fiery Emancipation.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2060-2919-3042-4222.description:
Activate Resplendent Mentor by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Resplendent Mentor.
Repeat.

2086-2919-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2743-4772-5461.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2743-4772-5461.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2073-2829-6522.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
4178-5702.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.
4178-5702.notes: The cost in step 6 can possibly be covered by the land played in step 5 on the first iteration, if the land is a Forest that enters untapped. This would make the starting cost of the combo {0}.

1912-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
When Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-4314-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

586-2292-5626-5687.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

141-147-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Black Sun's Twilight, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Black Sun's Twilight, giving Dualcaster Mage -5/-5 until end of turn and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Dualcaster Mage dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Black Sun's Twilight, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Black Sun's Twilight, giving Naru Meha -5/-5 until end of turn and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 3.
141-147-3645.notes: Since creatures with 0 or less toughness only go to the graveyard as a state-based action after the current spell or ability is finished resolving, Dualcaster Mage + Black Sun's Twilight is not a valid combo on its own. The creature must go to the graveyard before the spell starts resolving.

1920-3197-3891.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1920-3197-3891.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Elrond triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
